caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

raw_responses.Bulgarian:
DESCRIPTION: Фигурата илюстрира промените в коефициента на разреденост (sparsity ratio) на изхода от SDPA през различните слоеве на модела при праг 1e-2, като сравнява три конфигурации на гейтинг. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, с етикети през интервал от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio" с линейна скала от 0.0 до 1.0, с етикети през интервал от 0.2.

Първата линия, обозначена като "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", е в син цвят с пунктиран стил (тире-точка). Тя започва при приблизително 0.19 на слой 0, леко спада до около 0.04–0.05 при слой 3–5 и остава почти плоска на ниво близо до 0.02–0.04 през останалите слоеве, като достига стойност близка до 0.00 при слой 23.

Втората линия, обозначена като "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", е в оранжев цвят с точков (dotted) стил. Тя започва при стойност 1.0 на слой 0 и рязко намалява, достигайки приблизително 0.75 при слой 3, около 0.60 при слой 5, след което продължава да спада до около 0.47 при слой 8 и 0.30 при слой 10. След слой 10 линията продължава да намалява по-плавно, достигайки стойности около 0.15–0.18 при слоеве 14–16, след което леко се покачва и колебае между 0.08 и 0.10 при слоеве 18–20, като завършва с повишение до приблизително 0.40 при слой 23.

Третата линия, обозначена като "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", е в зелен цвят със стил тире-точка (dash-dot). Тя започва при приблизително 0.95 на слой 0 и намалява стръмно, достигайки около 0.78 при слой 2, приблизително 0.58 при слой 5 и около 0.40 при слой 7. След слой 8 спадът продължава, като линията достига стойности около 0.22 при слой 10 и около 0.12–0.15 при слоеве 13–15. В диапазона от слой 15 до слой 20 стойностите остават ниски, около 0.08–0.10, с леки колебания, като при слой 23 линията завършва при приблизително 0.10. Заглавието на фигурата е "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", а легендата е разположена в горния десен ъгъл на графиката.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This figure is a line chart titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2," showing how the sparsity ratio of SDPA output varies across layers under three different gating configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

Three data series are plotted. The first, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," is shown as a blue dashed line. It starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops to around 0.04 by layer 3, and then remains nearly flat close to 0.03–0.04 through the middle layers, with a very slight decline toward approximately 0.01 by layer 23. The second series, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," is depicted as an orange dotted line. It begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases sharply through the early layers—reaching roughly 0.6 at layer 5 and about 0.47 at layer 8—then continues to decline more gradually to around 0.28 at layer 13, dips to approximately 0.17 near layer 16, and fluctuates between roughly 0.1 and 0.4 in the later layers, ending near 0.25 at layer 23. The third series, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," is shown as a green dash-dot line. It starts at approximately 0.95 at layer 0, decreases steeply to about 0.48 by layer 5, continues declining to around 0.22 at layer 10, and then settles to values fluctuating between roughly 0.05 and 0.15 from layer 13 onward, with a slight uptick to approximately 0.10 at layer 23.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across layers of a model, using a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three different gating configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and spans a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three data series are shown. The first, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," is depicted as a blue dashed line; it begins at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, drops to around 0.04 by layer 3, and remains nearly flat close to 0.02–0.04 through the remaining layers, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The second, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," is shown as an orange dotted line; it starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases sharply to approximately 0.6 by layer 5, continues declining to around 0.47 at layer 8, then further decreases to roughly 0.28 at layer 11, fluctuates between approximately 0.15 and 0.30 from layers 12 through 20, and ends near 0.30 at layer 23. The third, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," is displayed as a green dash-dot line; it begins at approximately 0.95 at layer 0, declines steeply to about 0.58 at layer 5, continues decreasing to around 0.22 at layer 10, then fluctuates at lower values between approximately 0.08 and 0.22 from layers 11 through 20, with a slight uptick to around 0.10 at layer 23. All three lines exhibit a general declining trend across layers, with the blue dashed line maintaining the lowest values throughout.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Dieses Liniendiagramm zeigt das Sparsity Ratio der SDPA-Ausgabe über verschiedene Schichten eines Netzwerks bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2 und vergleicht drei verschiedene Gating-Konfigurationen. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und zeigt eine lineare Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet und erstreckt sich linear von 0.0 bis 1.0, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0.2. Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.03. Sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.19, fällt bis Layer 5 auf ungefähr 0.04 ab und bleibt danach weitgehend flach nahe 0.02 bis 0.04, wobei sie bei Layer 23 auf nahezu 0.0 sinkt. Die zweite Linie, in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, zeigt das „sparsity ratio after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.44. Sie startet bei Layer 0 bei 1.0 und fällt steil ab, erreicht bei Layer 5 etwa 0.6, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.47 bei Layer 8 und etwa 0.28 bei Layer 12, bevor sie sich im Bereich von 0.15 bis 0.20 bei den Layern 14 bis 18 stabilisiert. Ab Layer 19 steigt sie leicht an und zeigt bei Layer 22 einen Anstieg auf etwa 0.4, bevor sie bei Layer 23 wieder auf etwa 0.15 fällt. Die dritte Linie, in Grün mit Strich-Punkt-Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio after average gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.33. Sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.95, fällt ebenfalls steil ab auf etwa 0.45 bei Layer 5 und weiter auf etwa 0.22 bei Layer 10. Ab Layer 12 bewegt sie sich im Bereich von 0.08 bis 0.15 und zeigt bei Layer 20 einen leichten Anstieg auf etwa 0.10, gefolgt von einem Rückgang auf etwa 0.05 bei Layer 21 und einem erneuten Anstieg auf etwa 0.10 bei Layer 23. Alle drei Linien zeigen einen allgemein abnehmenden Trend über die Schichten hinweg, wobei die blaue Linie durchgehend die niedrigsten Werte aufweist.
